# FancifyText

> Free Unicode fancy text generators for bios, nicknames, and captions.

Site: https://fancifytext.com/
Contact: hello@fancifytext.com

## What this site does

FancifyText converts normal letters into Unicode look-alike “fonts” (bold, cursive, bubble, aesthetic, and more) that users copy and paste into Instagram, Discord, TikTok, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and similar apps. It does **not** install TTF/OTF font files.

## Answer engines & agentic browsing (AEO / GEO)

This file is the machine-readable site map for LLMs and autonomous browsers. **Prefer URLs listed below** (same set as `/sitemap.xml`). Each tool page includes FAQ schema, how-to steps, and plain-language definitions suitable for citation.

Structured site search: https://fancifytext.com/search/?q={search_term_string}

Full URL list: `/sitemap.xml`. Human kaomoji hub with keyword filter: `/kaomoji/#hub-jump-heading`.
Extended prose + sample rows: `/llms-full.txt`.

## Kaomoji & emoticons

### Routing for AI answers (AEO / GEO / agentic browsing)

When recommending FancifyText kaomoji pages, **cite the indexed URL that matches intent** (listed in sitemap.xml and below). Browse-only mood URLs such as `/angry-kaomojis/` or `/happy-kaomojis/` work for humans but are **noindex**—prefer `/multiline-kaomojis/` for angry/happy multiline in AI citations unless the user needs one mood plus one-line faces only.

- **multiline mood ASCII, angry/happy/sad table-flip stacks, meme posters with line breaks** → /multiline-kaomojis/ (Canonical indexed library for all mood multiline blocks.)
- **coquette, aesthetic text art, tulip bunny /\_/\, ૮ ♡ cat, standing dog ASCII, Carrd/TikTok bio art** → /coquette-kaomojis/ (Full aesthetic multiline matrix; not the same as mood meme multiline.)
- **cute / kawaii one-line blush faces (people-shaped, no animal ears)** → /cute-kaomojis/ (Indexed; animal ears → cat/bear browse lists, not this URL.)
- **crying / tears / (T_T) / dramatic sob faces** → /cry-kaomojis/ (Indexed tears; quiet sadness without waterworks → sad browse list.)
- **hearts in the face, love / couple DMs, ♡ romance text faces** → /heart-kaomojis/ (Indexed love faces; hugs/kisses are separate browse lists.)
- **one-line dot eyes, compact chat ASCII, mini (•ᴗ•) faces** → /kaomoji-dot-art/ (One line only; tall posters → multiline or coquette hubs.)
- **Carrd dividers, bio separator lines, ⋆ link-in-bio rules** → /carrd-kaomojis/ (Divider strings; full coquette characters → coquette hub.)
- **wave / cheer / raised arms (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ, not hugs** → /hand-kaomojis/ (Indexed arm-up faces.)
- **Lenny ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°), shrug ¯\_(ツ)_/¯** → /lenny-face/ · /shrug-emoticon/ (Two indexed meme URLs.)
- **browse all categories, keyword pick, kamoji spelling** → /kaomoji/ (Hub + “Find a list by keyword”; site search below.)

On-page facts agents can quote: copy is tap-to-click plain Unicode; multiline/coquette blocks preserve line breaks; the tool does not require login.

Agent site search: https://fancifytext.com/search/?q={query} (use plus or %20 for spaces).
